title: 1971 Porsche 911T Coupe 2.4L
description: This 1971 Porsche 911T coupe was delivered new to Martin-Johnson Porsche in Oakland, California, and is said to have remained in Northern California. It was stored between 1992 and 2012 when it underwent a mechanical overhaul. The current owner acquired the car in 2019 and had the flat-six engine built to 2.4 liters in 2022 totaling over $54k.
